description: This file defines custom guardrail classes for a Python-based API proxy system, intended for load balancing testing and input/moderation purposes. It includes hooks to modify or validate data before and after an API call.

classes.name: GuardrailForLBTestingA
classes.description: A custom guardrail class for load balancing testing, increments counter and logs calls.

classes.name: GuardrailForLBTestingB
classes.description: Another custom guardrail class for load balancing testing, distinct from A, increments counter and logs calls.

classes.name: myCustomGuardrail
classes.description: A custom guardrail with hooks to mask specific content in messages, reject calls containing certain words, and reject responses with certain content.

methods.name: Optional[Union[Exception,str,dict]] async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Hook runs asynchronously before the API call, can modify input data or reject the call.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Runs in parallel to the API call for moderation purposes, can reject the call based on content.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response, )
methods.description: Intercepts the response after a successful API call, can reject based on response content.
